notes: Operational release - MPIN/password logins now lock out for 10 minutes after 5 failed attempts (with audit trail); split-tender payments let one sale be paid across multiple methods (e.g. part cash + part GCash) with per-tender references and cash-only change, and partial payments can be completed later; direct thermal printing sends receipts and kitchen stubs straight to a network printer over TCP with no dialog, plus a TEST PRINT button in Store Settings.
